# /crav1-spark-to-spec

[All skills](../skills.md) · Walkthrough: [From one sentence to a spec](../../from-nothing.md) · Playbook: [`SKILL.md`](../../../.cursor/skills/crav1/crav1-spark-to-spec/SKILL.md)

## Purpose

Turn a one- or two-sentence spark into spec.md.

One-liner → questions → thin `docs/system/` when missing, including `glossary.md`, then `spec.md`, then one index row (greenfield, brownfield feature, or later feature on an existing landscape; new slug unless they extend). An existing landscape is left in place. A missing `glossary.md` is filled. New glossary rows are appended. Existing rows are not rewritten. A meaning the source does not state is `to be researched`. That same pass adds what is new to the short description, the diagram, and how the parts connect. It does not rewrite what is already there. On Azure Repos, offers once to write `work-item.md`.

## Runs when

You have 1–2 sentences. Called by the user.

This is one of the seven starter options. Asking for startup options names it and does not run it.

## Reads

In short: The spark, the repo.

Reads the spark and the repo.

## Writes

In short: `spec.md`, a thin `docs/system/` if missing (otherwise one index row and new glossary rows), the picture update, the slice `Synced at` line, `work-item.md` on an Azure Repos opt-in, and `Used by` on a quoted note.

Writes `docs/specs/<slug>/spec.md`, a thin `docs/system/` including `glossary.md` when that folder is missing, otherwise one index row plus a missing glossary or new glossary rows, and `work-item.md` when the user opts in on Azure Repos. A `repos.md` it writes includes a `Synced at` column and leaves that cell empty. When this run read only that slice's code, writes or updates `Synced at: <repo> <branch>@<short sha>, <date>` on that slice's `spec.md` and does not touch the repo column.

## Does not

Leaves application code and an existing landscape alone.

Limits and exceptions: extend edits that spec and adds no second index row. A quoted note in `docs/notes/` gets `Used by <slug>`. `Absorbed by <slug>` only after the user says yes, when this spec takes the whole note.
